backcard_card_name: SS Trunks, Tournament Battle to the Death
backcard_card_text:
[Auto][Once per turn] When you use a card in a combo, draw 1 card.
[Activate : Battle][Once per turn] If it’s your opponent’s turn and you have 1 or more red cards and 1 or more green cards in your Combo Area : During this turn, the next time you activate [Arrival Red/Green] on a <Vegeta> or <Trunks : Future> card in your hand, reduce the skill cost by (Red).
card_set: ZENKAI Series EX Set 08 LEGEND OF THE DRAGON BALLS [DBS-B25]
card_text:
[Permanent] Negate the [Energy-Exhaust] skill on Red/Green multicolor 《Saiyan》 cards in all of your areas.
[Auto][Once per turn] When your <Vegeta> or <Trunks : Future> card attacks, look at up to 5 cards from the top of your deck, add up to 1 《Saiyan》 or 《Earthling》 card―both red or green and with an energy cost of 4 or less―to your hand, then shuffle your deck.
[Awaken] When your life is at 4 or less, or you have 2 or more energy and {Vegeta, Rescuing a Son} in play : Draw 1 card, switch up to 1 of your energy to Active Mode, and add cards from your life to your hand until you have 6 life left.
